Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable

# Case 019: Garden Maintenance Request

Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable

arguments.summary: Routine garden job stuck at landlord gate for two months; landlord has never replied. A note says £500+VAT was approved, but there is no landlord wording on record and later holds contradict it. I sent a clear yes/no request, updated the tenant, and set a hold to 17 March.

answers.question: Where does this case stand, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: Landlord approval gate; no recorded landlord decision; the note of approval at event 009 is unverified. Outstanding: landlord decision, then contractor and visit.

answers.question: What is the next action, who for, which channel?
answers.answer: Landlord yes/no approval request by email (A1); tenant updated by email (A2); hold to 17 March (A3), then chase by phone/SMS.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision?
answers.answer: Not yet. Escalate only if the landlord stays silent after the 17 March chase.

conflicts: Event 009 says landlord approved £500+VAT with Harbour Compliance, but later holds say still waiting for landlord and no landlord words are on record; treated as unapproved.
